raw: [interlude(channel = 2, type = 2, name = "bg_black", afrom = 0, ato = 1, aduration = 0.3,sfrom = "1.3,1.3", sto = "1.3,1.3", sduration = 0, block = false)]
[Sticker(id="st1",  text="Sixty-four years ago...", duration=1,x=300,y=325, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0, width=700,block="false")]

content: Scar Market, Kazdel

raw: [name="Wounded Mercenary"]You protect this tag around your neck with your LIFE! You're MY precious property, slave!
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: You protect this tag around your neck with your LIFE! You're MY precious property, slave!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Wounded Mercenary"]You understand?! *Sarkaz swearing* You'd better be worth something.
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: You understand?! *Sarkaz swearing* You'd better be worth something.

raw: [name="Wounded Mercenary"]Stay here and don't move. You, you inspect the goods?
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: Stay here and don't move. You, you inspect the goods?

raw: The slave trader casts a glance at the silent slave behind the mercenary's back, then slightly shakes his head.
content: The slave trader casts a glance at the silent slave behind the mercenary's back, then slightly shakes his head.

speaker: Slave Trader
content: Where'd you get it?

raw: [name="Wounded Mercenary"]Found him on my way here, dying of thirst and about to become mangler chow. Thought he could fetch a good price.
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: Found him on my way here, dying of thirst and about to become mangler chow. Thought he could fetch a good price.

raw: [name="Timid Slave"]I... came from Kazdel... I can find someone who...
speaker: Timid Slave
content: I... came from Kazdel... I can find someone who...

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Doesn't matter to us where you're from, slave. Say you're Higashinese for all we care, as long as someone buys you out.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Doesn't matter to us where you're from, slave. Say you're Higashinese for all we care, as long as someone buys you out.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]I'm just checking if you've got a tail. You never know where these mercs get their 'goods'.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: I'm just checking if you've got a tail. You never know where these mercs get their 'goods'.

speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: I promise you he's clean.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]You better not be messing with me. Cash or barter?
speaker: Slave Trader
content: You better not be messing with me. Cash or barter?

raw: [name="Wounded Mercenary"]Ain't gonna live long enough for money to mean something. Give me some good weapons.
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: Ain't gonna live long enough for money to mean something. Give me some good weapons.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]You're the boss. He's second-rate, at best... that'll net you two blades, freshly cast.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: You're the boss. He's second-rate, at best... that'll net you two blades, freshly cast.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Wounded Mercenary"]How about you take another look, with your eyes open this time!
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: How about you take another look, with your eyes open this time!

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]You can dress him up as a first-rate, but it won't change anything. If you don't like our offer, feel free to get lost.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: You can dress him up as a first-rate, but it won't change anything. If you don't like our offer, feel free to get lost.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]And put that machete of yours away...
speaker: Slave Trader
content: And put that machete of yours away...

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]This is the Scar Market you're in.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: This is the Scar Market you're in.

raw: [name="Wounded Mercenary"]...Can you throw in more? I was out on the Leithanien border before I got back, I've got first-hand intel about the whole war in the Core—
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: ...Can you throw in more? I was out on the Leithanien border before I got back, I've got first-hand intel about the whole war in the Core—

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Well, here's something for nothing: careful what you spew out of that mouth if you want to stay alive here.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Well, here's something for nothing: careful what you spew out of that mouth if you want to stay alive here.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Mouthing around you have valuable 'first-hand intel'... You want to guess where that'll get you?
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Mouthing around you have valuable 'first-hand intel'... You want to guess where that'll get you?

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Leave the goods and scram. You're holding up the line.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Leave the goods and scram. You're holding up the line.

speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: *grunt*.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Not happy? Drown your sorrows in the bar. Our boss, Scareye, brews one heck of a drink. Doesn't matter if you can't pay your tab... they'll take your weapons as collateral, merc.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Not happy? Drown your sorrows in the bar. Our boss, Scareye, brews one heck of a drink. Doesn't matter if you can't pay your tab... they'll take your weapons as collateral, merc.

raw: [name="Wounded Mercenary"]One more thing... where do you run your bounty board? I'm here to strike it rich.
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: One more thing... where do you run your bounty board? I'm here to strike it rich.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]The barfolk'll be happy to inform you.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: The barfolk'll be happy to inform you.

speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: *Sarkaz swearing*.

raw: The merc stares around this floating hub, hidden away in the giant subterranean hollow beneath Kazdel.
content: The merc stares around this floating hub, hidden away in the giant subterranean hollow beneath Kazdel.

raw: Amidst the moans of the slaves, the faint yet constant rumble of lava and bursts of Originium dust can be heard rising from beneath the market.
content: Amidst the moans of the slaves, the faint yet constant rumble of lava and bursts of Originium dust can be heard rising from beneath the market.

raw: Eyeing the rugged path behind him, the mercenary recalls the perils he faced to reach here from the surface and shudders.
content: Eyeing the rugged path behind him, the mercenary recalls the perils he faced to reach here from the surface and shudders.

raw: [name="Wounded Mercenary"]Just how many people are there in that goddamn... chasm?
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: Just how many people are there in that goddamn... chasm?

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Enough to break your fall, if you jumped. Welcome to the Scar Market, greenhorn. You'll love it here.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Enough to break your fall, if you jumped. Welcome to the Scar Market, greenhorn. You'll love it here.

raw: [name="Wounded Mercenary"]What's the deal over there? Why the crowd?
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: What's the deal over there? Why the crowd?

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Probably another big name just rolled back into town.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Probably another big name just rolled back into town.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Aren't you here to 'strike it rich'? Go on, then. I'd rather keep my horns out of all that mess.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Aren't you here to 'strike it rich'? Go on, then. I'd rather keep my horns out of all that mess.

raw: The merc vaguely makes out a pale white figure flitting through the chaotic gloom of the street.
content: The merc vaguely makes out a pale white figure flitting through the chaotic gloom of the street.

raw: White clothes? You don't see that everyday in Kazdel.
content: White clothes? You don't see that everyday in Kazdel.
You're injured.

raw: [name="Wounded Mercenary"]Tell me something I don't know.
speaker: Wounded Mercenary
content: Tell me something I don't know.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.2, xstrength=10, ystrength=15, vibrato=25, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Slave Trader
content: Gkh! *cough* *cough*! You're—

raw: [name="???"]The last time I was here, it was someone else handling transactions.
content: The last time I was here, it was someone else handling transactions.

speaker: Slave Trader
content: Guh. Yes...

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]You're referring to my grandfather. He never stopped bragging about how he'd fought you and lived.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: You're referring to my grandfather. He never stopped bragging about how he'd fought you and lived.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]I'm surprised you'd remember him. In the good sense, though, that means he wasn't lying all this time. It must've been sixty years ago by now...
speaker: Slave Trader
content: I'm surprised you'd remember him. In the good sense, though, that means he wasn't lying all this time. It must've been sixty years ago by now...

speaker: Slave Trader
content: ...General Theresis.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Already? How sad that nothing here has changed at all.
speaker: Theresis
content: Already? How sad that nothing here has changed at all.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]I imagine with Her Highness here, too, there'll be no more violence this time, eh?
speaker: Slave Trader
content: I imagine with Her Highness here, too, there'll be no more violence this time, eh?

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Even if things get bloody, eventually you'll leave, but we'll always be here, General. We'll always have business, so long as Kazdel's unrest never rests.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Even if things get bloody, eventually you'll leave, but we'll always be here, General. We'll always have business, so long as Kazdel's unrest never rests.

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Even now, I remember one thing my grandpa mentioned in his boasts. He said to you, it's the land of Kazdel that needs us.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Even now, I remember one thing my grandpa mentioned in his boasts. He said to you, it's the land of Kazdel that needs us.

raw: Theresis looks at the slaves, their heads down in their cages. He draws his sword.
content: Theresis looks at the slaves, their heads down in their cages. He draws his sword.

raw: [name="Theresis"]War and turmoil have necessitated this trade for over a century... this Scar Market.
speaker: Theresis
content: War and turmoil have necessitated this trade for over a century... this Scar Market.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.2, xstrength=20, ystrength=15, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Timid Slave
content: G... General—I...

raw: [name="Theresis"]Provided you can reach the surface alive... Take a fresh look at Kazdel.
speaker: Theresis
content: Provided you can reach the surface alive... Take a fresh look at Kazdel.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Much of what you know will soon change. All Sarkaz will be part of this change.
speaker: Theresis
content: Much of what you know will soon change. All Sarkaz will be part of this change.

speaker: Slave Trader
content: All? Us too?

raw: [name="Theresis"]Yes. I'm not inclined to explain our vision to the likes of you. But I will stay here a while longer and wait for her return.
speaker: Theresis
content: Yes. I'm not inclined to explain our vision to the likes of you. But I will stay here a while longer and wait for her return.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Until then, I welcome you mercenaries to challenge me, just as sixty years ago.
speaker: Theresis
content: Until then, I welcome you mercenaries to challenge me, just as sixty years ago.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I will take you to Kazdel, willingly or otherwise.
speaker: Theresis
content: I will take you to Kazdel, willingly or otherwise.

raw: His voice isn't loud, but every Sarkaz present hangs onto his every word.
content: His voice isn't loud, but every Sarkaz present hangs onto his every word.

raw: The mixed-blood Sarkaz stands alone—no retinue, no army—armed only with an ordinary-looking longsword, casually held in the hand that wields it.
content: The mixed-blood Sarkaz stands alone—no retinue, no army—armed only with an ordinary-looking longsword, casually held in the hand that wields it.

raw: His steely gaze pierces through the dim of the street, settling calmly in the direction of the only person he cares for.
content: His steely gaze pierces through the dim of the street, settling calmly in the direction of the only person he cares for.

raw: [name="Theresa"]You can dismiss the mercenaries in ambush. No doubt they're your most trusted men.
speaker: Theresa
content: You can dismiss the mercenaries in ambush. No doubt they're your most trusted men.

raw: [name="Scareye"]This is out of my respect for the King of Sarkaz. None aside from the General can claim to know your true motives, after all.
speaker: Scareye
content: This is out of my respect for the King of Sarkaz. None aside from the General can claim to know your true motives, after all.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Your Highness, do you truly believe this can change the fate of the Sarkaz? That you're not just another ill-fated hero caught in this cycle of hope and failure?
speaker: Scareye
content: Your Highness, do you truly believe this can change the fate of the Sarkaz? That you're not just another ill-fated hero caught in this cycle of hope and failure?

raw: [name="Theresa"]Once the dust has all settled, your answer will come naturally.
speaker: Theresa
content: Once the dust has all settled, your answer will come naturally.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Following that pyrrhic victory, we built from zero a moving city, the great nomad of Sarkaz soil for over a century now.
speaker: Theresa
content: Following that pyrrhic victory, we built from zero a moving city, the great nomad of Sarkaz soil for over a century now.

raw: [name="Theresa"]We can evade Catastrophes and foreign armies. Our development has finally reached a point of basic self-sufficiency. But it's so far from enough.
speaker: Theresa
content: We can evade Catastrophes and foreign armies. Our development has finally reached a point of basic self-sufficiency. But it's so far from enough.

raw: [name="Theresa"]The storm has long been brewing on the horizon, but we were too oblivious, like a burdenbeast too slow to react, too old to move.
speaker: Theresa
content: The storm has long been brewing on the horizon, but we were too oblivious, like a burdenbeast too slow to react, too old to move.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Your Highness must be referring to that war between Leithanien and Gaul.
speaker: Scareye
content: Your Highness must be referring to that war between Leithanien and Gaul.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Surely you, too, are aware of the magnitude of that war.
speaker: Theresa
content: Surely you, too, are aware of the magnitude of that war.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Corsica I even secretly hired our Royal Court Casters as his consultants, but despite a period of seclusion, Leithanien's Witch King thwarted Gaul's offenses with his opening move.
speaker: Theresa
content: Corsica I even secretly hired our Royal Court Casters as his consultants, but despite a period of seclusion, Leithanien's Witch King thwarted Gaul's offenses with his opening move.

raw: [name="Theresa"]And now, Ursus and Victoria have also declared war on Gaul.
speaker: Theresa
content: And now, Ursus and Victoria have also declared war on Gaul.

raw: [name="Theresa"]These present empires display a might so far removed from the enemy one hundred and thirty years ago, against which we staked all Kazdel just to barely prevail.
speaker: Theresa
content: These present empires display a might so far removed from the enemy one hundred and thirty years ago, against which we staked all Kazdel just to barely prevail.

raw: [name="Theresa"]That was already a victory in name only. If Kazdel must now be thrust into the same situation, how could it possibly end?
speaker: Theresa
content: That was already a victory in name only. If Kazdel must now be thrust into the same situation, how could it possibly end?

raw: [name="Scareye"]It is for this end that you wish to establish the 'Military Commission of Kazdel'.
speaker: Scareye
content: It is for this end that you wish to establish the 'Military Commission of Kazdel'.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Yet, the old aristocrats of the Royal Court grow resentful, refusing to relinquish their sumptuous city lives and viewing this as an attempt to challenge their privileges.
speaker: Scareye
content: Yet, the old aristocrats of the Royal Court grow resentful, refusing to relinquish their sumptuous city lives and viewing this as an attempt to challenge their privileges.

raw: [name="Theresa"]A century of peace is enough for certain memories to slip their minds.
speaker: Theresa
content: A century of peace is enough for certain memories to slip their minds.

raw: [name="Scareye"]So, what made you deign to come here in person? Do you see the 'Scar Market' as the 'Royal Court' for the bottom-feeders, where the likes of us scape by and make merry?
speaker: Scareye
content: So, what made you deign to come here in person? Do you see the 'Scar Market' as the 'Royal Court' for the bottom-feeders, where the likes of us scape by and make merry?

raw: [name="Theresa"]My only hope is for more Sarkaz to join us and resist the voices that refuse to embrace change.
speaker: Theresa
content: My only hope is for more Sarkaz to join us and resist the voices that refuse to embrace change.

speaker: Scareye
content: Resist? Perhaps your Highness meant 'terrorize' and 'purge'.

raw: [name="Theresa"]What I want is a reform, not a slaughter.
speaker: Theresa
content: What I want is a reform, not a slaughter.

speaker: Scareye
content: So, what's the reward?

raw: [name="Scareye"]The Scar Market's not a real Royal Court. What we have with the mercenaries is partnership, not fealty. Without compensation, no one will work for us.
speaker: Scareye
content: The Scar Market's not a real Royal Court. What we have with the mercenaries is partnership, not fealty. Without compensation, no one will work for us.

speaker: Theresa
content: ...Reward?

raw: [name="Theresa"]Are the spoils of war not enough? Are the riches, power, or food that should have gone to the hungry people not enough to sate your appetite?
speaker: Theresa
content: Are the spoils of war not enough? Are the riches, power, or food that should have gone to the hungry people not enough to sate your appetite?

raw: [name="Theresa"]You claim to provide shelter and a livelihood for countless Sarkaz warriors with your rhetoric of justice... Yet, I could almost hear their bones crunch as you squeeze them dry for profit.
speaker: Theresa
content: You claim to provide shelter and a livelihood for countless Sarkaz warriors with your rhetoric of justice... Yet, I could almost hear their bones crunch as you squeeze them dry for profit.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Sorry, but in this business, we eat people whole and chew on their bones.
speaker: Scareye
content: Sorry, but in this business, we eat people whole and chew on their bones.

speaker: Theresa
content: Scareye.

raw: [name="Theresa"]You too are Sarkaz. You too are a part of Kazdel.
speaker: Theresa
content: You too are Sarkaz. You too are a part of Kazdel.

raw: While Theresa cannot see what expression lies behind Scareye's mask, his emotions are clear as day before her pitch-black crown.
content: While Theresa cannot see what expression lies behind Scareye's mask, his emotions are clear as day before her pitch-black crown.

raw: No commoner in Kazdel would ever dare defy the Royal Court.
content: No commoner in Kazdel would ever dare defy the Royal Court.

raw: But in his emotions, all Theresa sees is fervor and bloodthirst.
content: But in his emotions, all Theresa sees is fervor and bloodthirst.

speaker: Theresa
content: You won't refuse.

speaker: Scareye
content: ...Hah.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Why would I? Do you think I'm scared they'll take revenge on me? The Royal Court's no mystery to me, Your Highness knows that plenty well.
speaker: Scareye
content: Why would I? Do you think I'm scared they'll take revenge on me? The Royal Court's no mystery to me, Your Highness knows that plenty well.

raw: [name="Scareye"]And let me say... You've promised me, no doubt... the best 'reward' I could ask for.
speaker: Scareye
content: And let me say... You've promised me, no doubt... the best 'reward' I could ask for.

raw: [name="Scareye"]We thrive on chaos, and I can 'see' the level of chaos you will bring upon Kazdel.
speaker: Scareye
content: We thrive on chaos, and I can 'see' the level of chaos you will bring upon Kazdel.

raw: [name="Theresa"]The fact that you've kept the name 'Scar' tells me that your ideas haven't changed.
speaker: Theresa
content: The fact that you've kept the name 'Scar' tells me that your ideas haven't changed.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Like you said, the nations of Terra have grown tremendously in power over the last century. We could throw more revenants into the Soul Furnace and stoke its flames, but it'll not close that gap.
speaker: Scareye
content: Like you said, the nations of Terra have grown tremendously in power over the last century. We could throw more revenants into the Soul Furnace and stoke its flames, but it'll not close that gap.

raw: [name="Scareye"]So why force the people, who aren't really of the same race, to band together, call themselves the Sarkaz, and build a giant target called 'Kazdel'?
speaker: Scareye
content: So why force the people, who aren't really of the same race, to band together, call themselves the Sarkaz, and build a giant target called 'Kazdel'?

raw: [name="Scareye"]The war between the four superpowers has proven that other Terra nations can accept our existence as mercenaries, and that's where Scar Market comes in.
speaker: Scareye
content: The war between the four superpowers has proven that other Terra nations can accept our existence as mercenaries, and that's where Scar Market comes in.

raw: [name="Scareye"]And Your Highness surely knows that we've become a community, a town, because many of us could never fit into the elitist, bloodline-obsessed Royal Court.
speaker: Scareye
content: And Your Highness surely knows that we've become a community, a town, because many of us could never fit into the elitist, bloodline-obsessed Royal Court.

raw: [name="Scareye"]In all these years, I may have helped just as many Sarkaz find a new way of life as the Six Heroes, if not even more.
speaker: Scareye
content: In all these years, I may have helped just as many Sarkaz find a new way of life as the Six Heroes, if not even more.

raw: [name="Scareye"]And I'm not the least bit ashamed to say it, Your Highness, King of Sarkaz.
speaker: Scareye
content: And I'm not the least bit ashamed to say it, Your Highness, King of Sarkaz.

raw: Theresa doesn't reply. All she offers is a faint smile at the Cyclops.
content: Theresa doesn't reply. All she offers is a faint smile at the Cyclops.

raw: Ah. It suddenly occurs to Scareye that this King of Sarkaz belongs to no Royal Court and represents no bloodline.
content: Ah. It suddenly occurs to Scareye that this King of Sarkaz belongs to no Royal Court and represents no bloodline.

raw: Her sole aim is to persuade the Sarkaz who are unwilling to believe that Kazdel can be built, some of whom have even committed crimes for this cause, to believe once more.
content: Her sole aim is to persuade the Sarkaz who are unwilling to believe that Kazdel can be built, some of whom have even committed crimes for this cause, to believe once more.

raw: But is she enough to break free from this cycle of tragic failures, from the ending he foresaw?
content: But is she enough to break free from this cycle of tragic failures, from the ending he foresaw?

raw: [name="Scareye"]Come to think of it, there's one thing I don't get, Your Highness. I might have agreed to help you...
speaker: Scareye
content: Come to think of it, there's one thing I don't get, Your Highness. I might have agreed to help you...

raw: [name="Scareye"]But why didn't you and General Theresis simply burn this place to the ground before the day's end? I would have little chance of winning if you decided to do so.
speaker: Scareye
content: But why didn't you and General Theresis simply burn this place to the ground before the day's end? I would have little chance of winning if you decided to do so.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Just like you did sixty years ago.
speaker: Scareye
content: Just like you did sixty years ago.

raw: [name="Theresa"]A minute ago, you described 'Kazdel' as nothing but a target and that you want another way for the Sarkaz to live, one that would have them depend on other nations.
speaker: Theresa
content: A minute ago, you described 'Kazdel' as nothing but a target and that you want another way for the Sarkaz to live, one that would have them depend on other nations.

speaker: Scareye
content: Yes.

raw: [name="Theresa"]So tell me, in your prophetic visions, have you seen Kazdel's destruction?
speaker: Theresa
content: So tell me, in your prophetic visions, have you seen Kazdel's destruction?

raw: [name="Theresa"]Have you seen my death, Theresis's death, and the destruction of all that you stand against?
speaker: Theresa
content: Have you seen my death, Theresis's death, and the destruction of all that you stand against?

raw: [name="Theresa"]And what about yourself? How do you behold your death? A slow and agonizing death by Oripathy? Slain in battle on foreign soil? Or drowned in a sea of plots and conspiracies?
speaker: Theresa
content: And what about yourself? How do you behold your death? A slow and agonizing death by Oripathy? Slain in battle on foreign soil? Or drowned in a sea of plots and conspiracies?

raw: [name="Theresa"]Have you ever left this place, and seen Kazdel as it is now?
speaker: Theresa
content: Have you ever left this place, and seen Kazdel as it is now?

speaker: Theresa
content: Have you ever truly seen 'the future'?

raw: [name="Scareye"]Is this your way of asking for a prophecy? I don't give handouts, but for your Highness, I'll consider a discount.
speaker: Scareye
content: Is this your way of asking for a prophecy? I don't give handouts, but for your Highness, I'll consider a discount.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Such nerve. No wonder you were able to claw your way out of this bleakness and rebuild this mercenary's paradise.
speaker: Theresa
content: Such nerve. No wonder you were able to claw your way out of this bleakness and rebuild this mercenary's paradise.

speaker: Theresa
content: But I'll pass on the prophecy.

speaker: Theresa
content: Prophecies and fate have no value.

raw: [name="Theresa"]It's getting late. I look forward to your return to Kazdel.
speaker: Theresa
content: It's getting late. I look forward to your return to Kazdel.

raw: He watches her go and heaves a long sigh only when even her footsteps fall from earshot.
content: He watches her go and heaves a long sigh only when even her footsteps fall from earshot.
Son of a bitch.
Foresight? Prophecies? His own death?

raw: He bought his coffin this very morning.
content: He bought his coffin this very morning.

speaker: Scareye
content: Tally up the losses.

speaker: Slave Trader
content: Boss, the slaves...

raw: [name="Scareye"]Set them free. They're bound to get tangled up in the Scar Market after the war begins anyway. At most, we lose out on pocket change.
speaker: Scareye
content: Set them free. They're bound to get tangled up in the Scar Market after the war begins anyway. At most, we lose out on pocket change.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Did anyone take on General Theresis and survive?
speaker: Scareye
content: Did anyone take on General Theresis and survive?

raw: [name="Slave Trader"]Yes. I've noted them all down.
speaker: Slave Trader
content: Yes. I've noted them all down.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Take them to supplies for a little reward. They've got real balls.
speaker: Scareye
content: Take them to supplies for a little reward. They've got real balls.

raw: [name="Scareye"]When you're done, take them to the bar entrance and kill 'em all in front of everyone. Send their heads to General Theresis as an apology.
speaker: Scareye
content: When you're done, take them to the bar entrance and kill 'em all in front of everyone. Send their heads to General Theresis as an apology.

speaker: Slave Trader
content: ...Got it.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Send their rewards to whatever family and friends they have as bereavement.
speaker: Scareye
content: Send their rewards to whatever family and friends they have as bereavement.

raw: [name="Scareye"]Tell every merc looking to make a living in the Scar Market, I don't want to see 'anyone' trying funny shit on my turf.
speaker: Scareye

content: We will prepare Kazdel for the coming crisis, strive to eradicate the poverty and disease that have plagued them for millennia, and send a message to all of Terra.
